comparison_question: At fixed geometry, angular source, flux, physics list, and 100,000 gamma primaries, how does the historical factor-1000 energy axis change the TES deposited-energy spectrum?
gamma_model_boundary: unit-only total-gamma profile; the total spectrum already contains the historical broad-bin annihilation bump, so no mono-511 source is added

statistics.seed_policy: same legacy-control seeds across geometries for a geometry-matched diagnostic; disjoint from all corrected/production ledgers; never merge

  Usage: Cosima <options> <parameter file>
    Mandatory option:
         parameter file name (type: *.source)
    General options:
         -i:   start interactive mode
         -c:   convert to MEGAlib (file name)
         -s:   seed (integer > 0)
         -m:   macro file name (type: *.mac)
         -u:   do not gzip *.sim files (default is to gzip them)
         -z:   Not used: gzip *.sim files (already default, use -u to not zip them)
         -n:   No time out if no events are stored after 30 minutes (default is time out)
         -v:   verbosity (0: Basic Geant, 1: Standard, 2: Debug, 3: All Geant)
